description: Error-policy edge cases: an error delivered after initialization but before any listen (the user has not ended the session) is still forwarded and recorded; a transient error with cancel-on-error enabled does NOT stop the session (only permanent errors trigger the implicit cancel); and an error delivered after an explicit stop is suppressed.

cases.expected_output:
init result=true invoked=true
error msg=network permanent=false
listening=false recognized=false available=true has_error=true last_recognized= last_status= last_level=0.0

init result=true invoked=true
listen invoked=true locale=none
error msg=network permanent=false
listening=true recognized=false available=true has_error=true last_recognized= last_status=listening last_level=0.0

init result=true invoked=true
listen invoked=true locale=none
stop invoked=true
listening=false recognized=false available=true has_error=false last_recognized= last_status=listening last_level=0.0
